topic: Fundamentals of Vectors: Directions and Magnitudes
target_audience: High school students or beginners in STEM

sections.title: The Concept of Vectors vs. Scalars
lecture_lines: Vectors represent both magnitude and direction.
A cat's speed is a scalar.
Velocity towards a bowl is a vector.
Think of vectors as directional arrows.
animations: Draw a small white point labeled "Scalar" (#FFFFFF) next to a cat [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png].
Transform the point into a cyan arrow labeled "Vector" (#00FFFF).
Display text "Vector has magnitude and direction" in light blue (#ADD8E6).
Flash the cyan arrow to emphasize directionality.
Clear the scene while holding the "Vector" label and placing a bowl underneath it [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/bowl.svg].

sections.title: Visualizing Vector Components
animations: Draw a 2D plane with an arrow vector starting at origin in white (#FFFFFF).
Display MathTex components v_x (horizontal) and v_y (vertical) in light yellow (#FFFFE0).
Animate the dashed projection lines for v_x and v_y to form a right triangle.

sections.title: Vector Addition (The Parallelogram Rule)
lecture_lines: The resultant vector completes the parallelogram.
It shows the actual path taken.
animations: Draw vector A (red #FF4500) and vector B (blue #1E90FF) starting at origin using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pencil.svg].
Shift B to the head of A to show tail-to-head addition.
Draw the resultant vector C (yellow #FFD700) from origin to the new tip, measuring the angle with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/protractor.svg].

sections.title: Scalar Multiplication and Scaling
lecture_lines: Positive scalars keep the same direction.
animations: Draw vector V in light green (#90EE90) alongside the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg].
Display scaling factor 'c' (white #FFFFFF) and stretch V by factor c.
Toggle c to negative to reverse vector direction while updating MathTex, as if pulled by a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/spring.svg].

sections.title: Summary and Real-World Application
animations: Display summary text "Vectors define motion and position" in white (#FFFFFF).
Show a simplified car model [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/car.png] moving with a velocity vector arrow.
Fade out all graphical elements slowly.
